artifact: PHASE 4C remediation R1 - the independent audit findings, binding

findings.title: Batch reclassification can violate conservation and create capacity
findings.auditObservation: two elections of 25 + 25 against 40 of source usage both executed; source usage -10, remaining 110 on gross 100
findings.invariant: RECLASSIFICATION CANNOT CREATE ECONOMIC OR LEGAL CAPACITY: the sum a batch moves out of one source never exceeds what the source carries; a batch applies whole or not at all
findings.remediation: reclassification.ts: aggregate requested amounts by source over the whole batch against the before-state; AGGREGATE_SOURCE_USAGE_EXCEEDED on every drawer; BLOCKED_BY_BATCH_ATOMICITY on otherwise-valid elections; after is null when anything is blocked; batchConservation reported

findings.title: Duplicate ledger usage identity counted multiple times
findings.auditObservation: u1=30 and u1=80 both counted; capacity AVAILABLE with remaining 140 on gross 200 (P19); identical claimants likewise (P19b)
findings.invariant: USAGE CANNOT BE COUNTED TWICE THROUGH IDENTITY COLLISION: one immutable usage identity contributes at most once; duplicates are refused, never chosen between or collapsed
findings.remediation: ledger.ts: every record bearing a duplicated id is quarantined at index time; selectUsage fails any capacity the claimants could touch closed with DUPLICATE_LEDGER_USAGE_IDENTITY; state reports quarantinedUsageIds

findings.title: Duplicate shared-capacity identity resolves by array order
findings.auditObservation: two IRSharedCapacity with one id: last supplied became the pool, no limitation (P3)
findings.invariant: IDENTITY IS UNIQUE OR FAILS CLOSED: no first-wins or last-wins for any unique graph resource
findings.remediation: graph.ts: duplicate sharedCapId and ruleId detected before any node is built; the id is refused as a set with DUPLICATE_SHARED_CAPACITY_IDENTITY / DUPLICATE_RULE_IDENTITY; members of a refused pool are non-authoritative; state.ts refuses duplicates among the resources it is handed too; duplicate Phase-3 edges collapse to one canonical edge

findings.title: Capacity-state evaluation near-quadratic
findings.auditObservation: wall-clock log-log slope 1.81 on a chain-of-shares construction; about 8 s at 1,600 rules; artifact 11 claimed linear from counters that did not measure the nested scans
findings.invariant: CAPACITY EVALUATION MUST NOT HIDE AN ACCIDENTAL PAIRWISE ALGORITHM
findings.remediation: ledger indexed once by path with per-(path,currency) memoized selection; membership, component and dependency lookups indexed; graph existence checks by Set; manifest union keyed by identity; edge/dependency grouping in one pass; counters extended (ledgerEntriesExamined, sharedResourceLookups, dependencyLookups, indexLookups, edgesVisited as consulted)

findings.title: Phase-3 UNSUPPORTED legal state publishes authoritative AVAILABLE
findings.auditObservation: sufficiency UNSUPPORTED with an evaluable expression reported AVAILABLE with a gross amount (P16)
findings.invariant: LEGAL UNSAFETY CANNOT BE UPGRADED BY ARITHMETIC
findings.remediation: state.ts: SUFFICIENCY_DOMINANCE is a Record over every RepresentationSufficiency value (compile-time exhaustive) with a fail-closed default for values outside the union; unsafe entity scope is REVIEW_REQUIRED; published amounts withheld and arithmetic kept under provisional
probes: matrices R8 table over all six values + scopes

findings.title: Empty allocation candidate information silently dropped
findings.auditObservation: UNRESOLVED path with no candidates left every capacity AVAILABLE at full amount (P15)
findings.invariant: 'no usage applies' is never confused with 'usage exists but attribution cannot be determined'
findings.remediation: ledger.ts: unresolved-without-candidates blocks every capacity in scope with ALLOCATION_INFORMATION_MISSING; candidates entirely outside the graph are reported as USAGE_NOT_ATTRIBUTABLE_IN_GRAPH, never dropped

findings.title: Snapshot ambiguity signalling inconsistent
findings.auditObservation: ambiguous=true for two snapshots supplying different facts (benign) and false for the same fact in two snapshots (conflict); the flag was `snapshotIds.size > 1`
findings.invariant: ambiguity is an actual Phase-4B conflict (AMBIGUOUS_INPUT / SNAPSHOT_SET_UNSAFE), never set size
findings.remediation: state.ts: ambiguous derives from evaluation diagnostics; multiSnapshot and conflictingInputKeys added; AMBIGUOUS_FINANCIAL_INPUT limitation on the capacity

findings.title: Symmetric legal relationships classified as dependency cycles
findings.auditObservation: every Phase-3 relationship became DEPENDS_ON and fed cycle detection; 5 of 5 real-corpus cycles were symmetric SHARES_CAPACITY_WITH pairs
findings.invariant: SYMMETRIC LEGAL RELATIONSHIPS ARE NOT AUTOMATICALLY COMPUTATIONAL CYCLES; true evaluation cycles still fail closed
findings.remediation: graph.ts: LEGAL_RELATIONSHIP edge kind for every non-reclassification relationship; DEPENDS_ON only from RULE_REFERENCE inside a capacity expression; cycle detection runs over EVALUATION_DEPENDENCY_EDGE_KINDS only

findings.title: Unquantified SHARES_CAPACITY_WITH leaves the member authoritative
findings.auditObservation: SHARED_CAPACITY_NOT_QUANTIFIED at graph level while the member entry read AVAILABLE at full amount (P1, P2)
findings.invariant: UNKNOWN SHARED CAPACITY CANNOT BECOME AUTHORITATIVE AVAILABILITY
findings.remediation: graph.ts records unquantifiedSharedWith on both ends of the relationship; state.ts makes such entries REVIEW_REQUIRED with effectiveRemaining NOT_DETERMINED and the local arithmetic under provisional; no pool is invented

findings.title: Duplicate-id tests asserted codes only
findings.auditObservation: the original duplicate-usage test checked LEDGER_SET_UNSAFE and never the applied amounts, which is why F2 escaped it
findings.invariant: a test of an identity invariant asserts the code AND the arithmetic
findings.remediation: the original test replaced with one asserting status, code, applied ids, usage, remaining and the forbidden amounts; forensic P19/P19b likewise

findings.title: Supplied negative usage creates capacity (audit register)
findings.invariant: consumption is reduced only by status or supersession; a negative row is representable only as the source half of a conserved reclassification pair with its destination half present
findings.remediation: ledger.ts: USAGE_AMOUNT_NOT_REPRESENTABLE issue + block; the capacity fails closed

findings.title: Duplicate election ids execute (audit register)
findings.auditObservation: both elections with one id executed, allExecuted true (P8)
findings.invariant: an election identity applies at most once; fail closed, never deduplicate
findings.remediation: reclassification.ts: DUPLICATE_ELECTION_IDENTITY on every bearer; ELECTION_ALREADY_APPLIED when the ledger already carries the election's rows

findings.title: Unproduced kinds and unreachable code documented as supported (audit register)
findings.auditObservation: LEDGER_USAGE, CONSUMES listed as kinds; CROSS_INSTRUMENT_NOT_REPRESENTED unreachable; movesUsageIds unused; PATH_NOT_THIS_CAPACITY
findings.invariant: the evidence package names what is produced and what is reserved
findings.remediation: artifacts 02/03/08 split produced vs reserved; PATH_NOT_THIS_CAPACITY removed (no longer produced since indexing); movesUsageIds documented as provenance-only

findings.title: Gate condition 32 loosened post hoc (audit register)
findings.auditObservation: condition 32 changed from 'full suite clean' to 'no attributable regressions' after the first run, without disclosure
